title: Quasidiagonal traces need not form a face
summary: Let \(G\) be an infinite residually finite countable discrete group with Kazhdan's property~\((T)\). Assume that its finite-dimensional irreducible unitary representations admit an exhaustive ordering with nondecreasing dimensions tending to infinity and bounded consecutive dimension ratios. From this data we construct a separable unital residually finite-dimensional \(C^*\)-algebra with a faithful quasidiagonal tracial state \(τ=\frac14μ_1+\frac34μ_2\), where \(μ_1\) is not quasidiagonal.
